extracted.name: Pink Summer Beer
extracted.description: This summer beer recipe is fun to make with pink lemonade, vodka, and beer for a crowd-pleasing icy cocktail at summertime gatherings or parties.
ingredient_lines: 1 (12 fluid ounce) can frozen pink lemonade concentrate, thawed
1 (12 fluid ounce) can or bottle beer
instruction_lines: Place lemonade concentrate in a gallon pitcher. Measure water and vodka in the 12 ounce lemonade can and add to the pitcher. Pour in the beer, mix well and serve over ice.
